title: Backend: Rule Engine
description: Implement rule expression parser and evaluator in src/strategy_backtest/rules.py. Support cross_over, cross_under, gt, lt, and, or operators. Parse rule expressions into an AST, evaluate against indicator columns in DataFrame, return boolean signal series for buy/sell decisions.

criteria: parse_rule('cross_over(ma_5, ma_20)') returns structured AST node
parse_rule('ma_5 > ma_20') returns comparison AST node with gt operator
evaluate_rules(df, ['cross_over(ma_5, ma_20)']) returns boolean Series with True on crossover days
evaluate_rules supports and/or composition: 'cross_over(ma_5, ma_20) and macd_dif > macd_dea'
cross_over(A, B) returns True on day i where A[i-1] <= B[i-1] AND A[i] > B[i]
cross_under(A, B) returns True on day i where A[i-1] >= B[i-1] AND A[i] < B[i]
gt/lt operators support indicator vs indicator, indicator vs constant comparisons
Multi-rule evaluation: buy_rules list is AND-combined (all must be True for signal)
Edge case: first row of data has no prior values for cross_over/cross_under (returns False)
convergence.definition_of_done: Rule engine correctly parses and evaluates all 6 operators with proper edge case handling

files.change: Create rule engine with parse_rule, evaluate_rule, evaluate_rules functions supporting cross_over, cross_under, gt, lt, and, or

implementation.title: Design AST node structure
implementation.description: Define dataclasses for AST nodes: ComparisonNode (gt/lt), CrossoverNode (cross_over/cross_under), LogicalNode (and/or), ValueNode (column reference or constant)

implementation.title: Implement parser
implementation.description: Parse rule expression strings into AST. Handle function calls (cross_over, cross_under), operators (>, <, and, or), column references, and numeric constants.

implementation.title: Implement evaluator
implementation.description: Evaluate AST against DataFrame. Crossover detection uses shifted Series comparison. Logical operators use pandas bitwise operators.

implementation.title: Handle edge cases
implementation.description: First-row handling for crossover (no prior value), NaN propagation from indicators, empty rule list
actions: Test first row returns False for crossover

reference.pattern: Simple recursive descent parser or regex-based parser for rule expressions
reference.examples: PRD section 7 buy_rules/sell_rules JSON examples: 'cross_over(ma5, ma20)', 'macd.dif > macd.dea', 'close < boll.lower'

rationale.chosen_approach: Custom lightweight parser with AST representation. Recursive evaluation against pandas Series.
rationale.tradeoffs: Limited to 6 operators, but covers all PRD requirements without complexity

unit: test_evaluate_crossover: verify crossover detection on synthetic data
test_evaluate_gt_lt: verify comparison with constants and columns
test_first_row_edge_case: verify crossover returns False on first row
test_nan_handling: verify NaN columns don't crash evaluator
success_metrics: All 6 operators produce correct boolean signals
